experience.company: Collaborated with Operations, Technology, and Business teams to support front-to-back trade lifecycle processes
responsibilities: Led requirement analysis for SocGen's Prime Brokerage platform (10M EUR transformation initiative), collaborating with trading, risk, and operations stakeholders to define business needs and translate them into functional specifications, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows and business documentation. Ochestrated migration of 18 downstream applications from legacy platforms to Azure Data Lake, ensuring seamless data transition, validation, and uninterrupted business operations. Designed and implemented pricing automation and validation control framework, ensuring high-quality market data ingestion, reducing pricing errors, and eliminating manual checks equivalent to 1 FTE daily. Spearheaded automation of Equities, Funds, Options, and Futures contract creation in our system, reducing manual effort by 30% and saving 1 FTE daily while accelerating time-to-market. Owned end-to-end reference data lifecycle (creation, amendment, maintenance) across Derivatives, Equities, FX, and Commodities, ensuring 100% compliance with exchange and regulatory standards. Drove end-to-end migration of referential data from Oracle-based legacy systems to Azure Data Lake, contributing to significant infrastructure cost optimization and scalable enterprise data access. Managed JIRA backlogs, sprint planning, user story refinement, delivery tracking, RAID logs, dependency management,

Facilitated stakeholder workshops to elicit business requirements, perform impact analysis, and support end-to-end solution delivery across cross-functional teams. Demonstrated strong functional expertise across Cash Equities, FX, Derivatives, Commodities, Funds, Indices, and OTC products, supporting front-to-back trade lifecycle processes, data governance, reconciliations, regulatory reporting, and transformation initiatives.
including trade capture, validation, settlement, lifecycle events, and exception management across multiple asset classes.

Conducted daily market price validation and exception management, investigating pricing discrepancies and ensuring accurate valuation data across asset classes. Managed corporate actions lifecycle for Equities and Derivatives, including symbol changes, stock splits, mergers, instrument ID updates, and strike price adjustments. Supported regulatory reporting initiatives for MiFID II and EMIR by maintaining accurate security reference data and ensuring compliance with reporting requirements. Played a key role in the EUREX NEXTGEN migration, successfully supporting trade rebooking, product onboarding, and implementation of daily and weekly expiry instruments with no downstream impact.
